sections.label: Verification checks
sections.description: Execution, result, reasons and provider decisions for every requested check.

sections.label: Business identities
sections.description: Candidates and resolved legal entities, without equating a search hit with verification.

sections.label: Person identities
sections.description: Authorized borrower and related-person identity attributes.

sections.label: Registry registrations
sections.description: Legal status, good standing, registration authorities and annual-return compliance.

sections.label: Addresses
sections.description: Registered, records, operating, service and residential addresses and validation.

sections.label: People and control
sections.description: Directors, officers, agents, signatories, parent entities and guarantors.

sections.label: Ownership interests
sections.description: Direct, indirect, economic and voting interests, with unresolved ownership explicit.

sections.label: Identity documents
sections.description: Document identity, authenticity, expiry, NFC and wallet assurance.

sections.label: Biometric check results
sections.description: Liveness and face comparison results without biometric media or templates.

sections.label: Screening results
sections.description: Sanctions, PEP, watchlists and adverse-media candidates with review disposition.

sections.label: Tax identifier validation
sections.description: TIN, EIN, BN and VAT validation, distinct from tax payment compliance.

sections.label: Regulatory registrations
sections.description: Jurisdiction-specific licences, authorizations, classifications and registration status.

sections.label: Corporate filings
sections.description: Dated corporate events, annual returns and document references.

sections.label: Corporate structure
sections.description: Share classes, voting rights, restrictions, capital and governing provisions.

sections.label: Legal and public records
sections.description: Liens, judgments, litigation, bankruptcy and licensed consortium observations.

sections.label: Business online presence
sections.description: Business websites, directories, reviews and business social profiles.

sections.label: Contact verification
sections.description: Email and phone verification, deliverability, carrier and fraud signals.

sections.label: Device and location signals
sections.description: Coarse location, network integrity and consistency observations.

sections.label: Document analysis
sections.description: Document extraction, tamper and cross-document consistency results.

sections.label: Bank ownership
sections.description: Account-holder matching and verification method, separate from financial analysis.

sections.label: Declarations and questionnaires
sections.description: Versioned borrower declarations, repeatable answers and file references with declared provenance.

sections.label: Signature evidence
sections.description: Signer identity, authority, consent and signature validation evidence.

sections.label: Field comparisons
sections.description: Submitted versus observed values, thresholds and exact matching outcomes.

sections.label: Source scores
sections.description: Original provider scales, ratings and reason codes; never an AMLOK credit probability.

sections.label: Duplicate identity signals
sections.description: Authorized same-workspace matches with identifiers minimized.
